title: Microsoft Corporation — Annual Report (SYNTHETIC FIXTURE for offline demo/evals)
body:
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — This document is an invented excerpt in the style of a 10-K, bundled for offline demos and evaluation. Its figures are fictional and must not be used as financial data.

ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Microsoft Corporation develops and supports software, services, devices and solutions. Revenue for fiscal 2025 was $261.8 billion, an increase of 14 percent. The Intelligent Cloud segment, which includes Azure, server products and enterprise services, reported revenue of $105.4 billion. Azure and other cloud services revenue grew 29 percent year over year, driven by consumption of AI infrastructure services. The Company's Copilot family of AI assistants is now embedded across Microsoft 365, GitHub, Dynamics 365 and Windows.

ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS

The Company is making significant capital investments in datacenters, servers and custom silicon to meet demand for AI services; capital expenditure for fiscal 2025 was $55 billion. If demand for AI services does not develop as expected, the Company may not realise an adequate return on these investments. Datacenter expansion is also constrained by the availability of electrical power and grid interconnection in key regions, and by the supply of advanced GPUs. The Company faces intense competition in cloud and AI services from established and emerging competitors, and evolving AI regulation in the European Union and elsewhere may increase compliance costs or constrain product offerings.

ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

Operating income for fiscal 2025 was $118.6 billion, an increase of 16 percent. Microsoft Cloud revenue, which aggregates Azure, Microsoft 365 commercial, LinkedIn commercial and Dynamics 365, was $158.7 billion, up 21 percent. During the year the Company returned $46.1 billion to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases and raised its quarterly dividend by 10 percent. Headcount at fiscal year end was approximately 228,000 full-time employees. The Company expects capital expenditure to increase in fiscal 2026 as it continues to scale AI infrastructure.
